question: Choose the figure that is different from the others (odd man out).

why: Each figure is a plus sign with one arm bent at its end. Walking out along the bent arm, the bend turns to your left in options 1, 2 and 3. In option 4 the bend turns to the right, so it is a mirror image.
trick: For plus/swastika shapes, check the direction of each bend (left or right turn).
